POOL CON: RAPID POOLS

By: Nicky Troll | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A new sparkling pool is what you’re promised, what you get is a hole in the ground if you’re lucky – sometimes the Rapid Pools crew just pocket the deposits and do a quick duck.

Unique Selling Point:
- CHRONIC SCAMSTER – OVER 50 case studies, history of bad workmanship and non-delivery going back to 2016
- VIEWERS LOVES A CROOK GETTING BUST

Summary:
Rapid Pools con new clients with proposals and so-called experience - claiming to have finished 300 sparkling pools. Yet we've only tracked down endless upset clients without sparkling pools.

Rapid Pools’ MO is simple: Take a deposit, start some work, don’t finish the job! Leaving clients with a ghastly pit in their gardens when they were dreaming of a sparkling pool. People have been ripped off between R10 000 to R220 000.

We go undercover to expose these scamsters - outing them once and for all.


Further information:
Rapid Pools’ MO is simple: Take a deposit, start some work, don’t finish the job! Leaving clients with a ghastly pit in their gardens when they were dreaming of a sparkling pool. People have been ripped off between R10 000 to R220 000.

They owe suppliers and employees – they simply leave a trail of unpaid bills, unfinished jobs with endless promises to make good – but these promises very rarely materialise. And when they do the workmanship is questionable.

RAPID POOLS
Rapid Pools and Construction (2016/131234/07) owned by Guthrie (GUS) Cayle Fisher and Amy Crystal Fisher. Long history of acquiring deposits from respective clients and fail to deliver the service as promised, with an exception of 5% of swimming pools completed with inferior materials.

Amy is the one that goes out quotes and deals with clients – we are hoping to catch her!

EXCUSES
They make promises/commitments prior to customers paying, and thereafter refer to their SLA agreement and ignore all agreements and commitments made prior to paying. They provide various excuses for not attending to the site, such as ‘floods’, ‘material supplier issues’, ‘Gus the owner is sick’, etc. None of these are valid excuses and are also not communicated to their customers. No updates of delays are provided.

LIKES TO THREATEN PEOPLE
An extensive amount of evidence were found were the owner Guthrie (Gus) Fisher threatened and intimidated any victims that tried to warn others or posted on social media in the public’s interest and his lawyer Chinette de Beer from Hinrichsen Attorneys would harass and intimidate clients to remove any negative reviews posted to warn others. Although the publication states factual events of their customer experience, they would be threatened with a ‘defamation of character’ lawsuit, in order for them to remove their publication. Many started posted anonymously due to threats.


CASE STUDIES
CASE STUDY 1 - CHRISTELLE VAN HEERDEN
Started dealing with Rapid Pools in May 2019 – wanted to renovate existing pool and add a splash pool – Met with Amy initially - paid R10 000 deposit in July – waited 3 weeks – no work done. Staff were dropped three times as the property, for between an hour to three – very little work done. If anything they are now worse off then when they started. They were promised it would be finished in August for her husband’s bday, then for her 10 year old daughter’s bday. She has a great pic of all the children in the hole for her daughter’s party.

CASE STUDY 2 - MAGEN REDDY
Started dealing with Rapid Pools 9 months ago – Amy came out to quote. Only dealt with Amy. Paid for the pool – R60K + in total. The payments were structured in terms of milestones – final two payments were made because Rapid Pools said nothing can be done if they don’t pay up – it would delay materials needed to finish. Magen paid up, they didn’t finish. Last work was done two / three months ago. At this stage he has a concreted pool – a bit of the coping and installed a pump – but no fibre glassing. Amy came out last week to see them to tell them the investigation on FB is fraudulent – promised to finish the work this week – never come. He has a recording – mentioning she will complete it. Amy claims there’s only one upset client.

CASE STUDY 3 – 2016/2017 client
Finding this person still – choosing best option – looking for someone who dealt with them way back to show pattern over the years.

OPERATING OUTSIDE OF CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT
In all instances whereby a client requested a start or end date of their project, Rapid Pools would refer back to their SLA agreement which is against the CPA. The SLA agreement state that there is no timeline available and clients are not allowed to request this. The SLA agreement also state that deposits are ‘non-refundable’. Once the customer start to become impatient with the lack of service, they would get a notification that they ‘breached contract’ and then Rapid Pools seem to feel entitled to keep the deposits without the service rendered

EXPERTS
The National Spa and Pool Institute of South Africa – we interview them as experts what can people look out for - we get them to look at one of the pool and give their expert opinion on the quality of work. But more sexy is the fact Rapid Pools attempted to register with them in the past but were rejected. Rapid pools used the NSPI logo on their advertisements which is a misrepresentation. They were instructed by NSPI to remove their logo from all their advertisements. NSPI also received multiple complaints from various Rapid Pools clients. Rapid Pools have publicly indicated that the NSPI is one of their competitors and trying to dictate industry standards, is jealous of their success and sees them as a threat to their members

SUPPLIERS & STAFF
We have a hardware store that is owed money, staff that have not been paid – we can interview them on camera as well.

INVESTIGATOR – John Alexander
John has been tracking Rapid Pools and has pieced together their dodgy dealing having tracked down upset clients all over Gauteng dating back to 16 – he becomes a nice thread to show the extent of these pool cons.

HOW TO DO IT
- FOOTAGE – We do two undercover stings at different houses – one for sales pitch and hidden camera footage. The second for the bust.

WE HAVE AN ADDRESS FOR THEIR HOME, WE WILL HAVE EYES ON THEM IN THE MORNING OF THE BUST – I AM CONFIDENT WE CAN TRACK THEM DOWN.

Script:


STRUCTURE POOL CON

VO: A sparkling pool is an investment for many South Africans. It’s one of those home improvement projects that people aspire to and many painstakingly save towards.

LINK: Contractors are quick to promise you the world – you’re expecting a sparkling new pool, but what you get is a hole in the ground and a contractor who never seems to pitch up.

VO: One of these contractors is Rapid Pools & Construction - run by husband and wife team Gus & Amy Fisher. They claim to have a wealth of experience.

GUS: We’ve done it - If you can think it we can do it.

VO: When we called them for quote - Gus himself showed up.

GUS: We’ve just finished our 300th one about a couple of weeks ago - // and we are backed by // one of the biggest suppliers in Gauteng. // When we need something we can get it – we don’t have to wait.

VO: But if you go by what many of their clients say – waiting is the one thing you are guaranteed of when it comes to Rapid Pools.

These three homeowners were impressed by the Rapid Pools sales pitch - but they have yet to get the sparkling pools they were promised.

Magen Reddy: was quoted R63 000 for a new pool – he has paid in full. 9 months later - This is his pool .

MAGEN: // Always whenever you speak to them it's always the next week. // next week never comes.

VO: Hannes Scholtz: was Quoted: R50 000 for a new pool and two flowerbeds. With R30 000 paid, 7 months in – this is his pool .

HANNES: If you the phone there is always this excuse // these other sites also behind, there’s rocks the other site and rain and things like that. INT2 M2

VO: Christelle van Heerden: was Quoted: R43 000 for a pool renovation and the addition of a martini pool. She’s paid R30 000, but 2 months since her initial deposit – this is her pool .

CHRISTELLE: in total they were here four days. Not consecutively. At most maybe between 2 and 4 hours mostly because they didn't have materials

VO: Private investigator John Alexander has been on the Rapid Pools case for the last two months he says the company over-promises and under delivers.

JOHN: The modus operandi. If I look at it from my side is basically quote as lowest possible ensure you get the job, get a deposit and just give the client a run for everything they have

VO: Paying a deposit will eventually get you a hole dug up. After that, Rapid Pools will need more money, then it’s a waiting game before they come back to site.

MAGEN: I paid both the payments….. I waited and then I waited //

VO: It seems at Rapid Pools has some explaining to do – so we booked another quote – this time Gus’ wife and co-director – Amy – showed up .

UPSOUND SOME ALLEGATIONS

VO: After calling her lawyer, she sat down for an interview.

AMY: I don’t know where you getting that we aren’t doing the right thing and that we haven’t completed pools // Would you like to see some photos of pools

VO: On their Facebook page there are a number of pools, some even recently completed. Rapid Pools sent us a list of 6 so-called happy clients. Our own research revealed – of the 6 - one was happy, four got pools but say they will never recommend the company, and the last one didn’t even get a pool, he never even got his deposit refunded..

UPSOUND: DONOVAN
UPSOUND: HENDRIK

VO: We contacted an additional 83 Rapid Pools clients from 2018 & 2019 – 69 of them did not get a completed pool having made phase payments ranging from 10 to 75 000 rand. These are some photos of Rapid Pools’ work.

Rapid Pools questioned the figures of clients we contacted versus apparent pools incomplete stating: it “is very wrong... and in our eyes...impossible as we bragged of a 100% completion rate...up until early this year.”

We telephonically contacted each of the 83 clients we refer to – they all have similar stories. Our undercover operative was also promised a quick turn around job.

PRODUCER: How long does it take to do a pool?
GUS: You’ve got your first 10 days, then the concrete must stand for 10 days – then the finishes is 10 days – so you can work on worst case scenario, work on a month. / 0006 M1

JOHN: // when you turn around and you said okay you know what I've been waiting for six months in it will tell you it's not 15 consecutive days //

VO: None the 83 people we spoke to got a new pool within a month – there were endless delays in the majority of cases.

MAGEN: //Basically anything that affects South Africa affects them. They find some way to type into the construction

DEVI: ever built in 20 days
AMY – not consecutive
DEVI: can’t get done?
AMY: – cant get done
DEVI: Delays? M15
AMY: because rain – we hit rock, supplier delays – protests – how do you want us to work in conditions like that?
DEVI: you are making excuses
AMY: you can think whateer you want

VO: Some of their clients think they’re scamsters .

CHRISTELLE: // they are thieves and they get away with it every day. // taking people's hard earned money // and then have the audacity to threaten all of us with legal action // INT3 M32

VO: Clients are reguluarly referred to the detailed Rapid Pools service level agreement, or SLA, that they were given with the quote.

LINK: As a consumer you might think a detailed contract and service level agreement will have you covered – but if the contractor isn’t honourable you could be in deep water.

VO: The contract is one sided , more than half of all the people we spoke to said they were threatened with breach of contract.

JOHN: If you go to social media, you're in breach of contract you will lose the deposits and you won't finish the job you won't finish a job. But that's what he wants it's a one sided contract is to protect him and then only.

AMY – // client agrees to the terms of the contract.
DEVI – do you know your contract is actually invalid?
AMY – The accepted the contents – my attorneys drafted up this.
DEVI – constitution and laws of country
AMY – yah – CPA is for clients //

REGGIE: No it's definitely for her - that's why the act is there to balance the interests of the supplier and also the consumer.

VO: Attorney Reginald Thsabalala assessed the Rapid Pools contract. He found it to be vague, misrepresentative and in contravention of the constitution and the National Credit Act.

REGGIE: You can’t choose // whatever pleases you in the contract and see that it's binding in a country such as ours where there are laws and see that you will you will operate in isolation to our laws.

VO: But Amy & Gus believe they’re in the right and are quick to take clients on when they start complaining – threatening them with defamation lawsuits .

REGGIE: Something which is true that cannot serve as a justifiable reason to cancel a contract but in any event those contracts are unenforceable, they’re invalid

VO: Gus is the one who usually responds to clients who dare to complain on social media.

We interviewed him at home.

DEVI: called people names
GUS: I did
DEVI: unnecessary – not on
GUS: I’ve apologised – not one sided // 16.45
DEVI: you’re not the victim here you know that right

VO: Of the 83 people we contacted – 14 got pools – but only 1 was happy with their dealings with Rapid Pools . Besides complaints about delays and threats of legal action – some of these clients felt the workmanship was not up to scratch.

The Nastional Spa and Pool Institute is a voluntary self-regulatory body of pool builders. Committee member Julian Burch says Rapid Pools is not a member.

JULIAN: They applied for membership. // They were declined on the basis that they they they didn't conform to the NSPI standards.

VO: Rapid Pools feel the NSPI is not independent because the inspectors belong to rival companies.

GUS: There’s no ways a competitor is going to pat us on the back.

LINK: When it comes to buidling a pool taking shortcuts or to skimping on materials is a certain road to disaster – in the end the art of pool making requires serious skills and expertise.

VO: We asked the NSPI to inspect the work done at Hannes Scholtz’ property.

JULIAN: there's a couple of issues there gunnite work. Yeah it's a hand pack but it's still very soft in places. // the weirs the turns the lights they should have all been bolted in the construction phase. // from what I can see, there's no ring beam on the top of the pool which is important for the overall structure

GUS: We wouldn’t be where we are today if our work was that bad

VO: With only 2% of the clients we called, happy with completed pools – It seems the company has been overreaching and taking on too much work , yet they are still quoting for new jobs.

DEVI: Don’t you think that is quite an arrogant – back on all your pools – the ones you need to get done are not done – yet you pitch up here for quotes
AMY: attending to all these clients
DEVI:
AMY: client say they want to start looking at qutoes for new year

VO: That wasn’t the case in our first undercover sting.

PRODUCER: It would be nice if you could start in the next two - three weeks
GUS: Yah, no we can, yah.

JOHN: At this point is just trying to stay afloat. //Based on my investigations the rapid pools doesn't have any funds

DEVI: I think cash flow problem
GUS: because sites were being stretched out – it was hitting our pockets // a merger s happening therir pools will be finished by next weekendw
DEVI: how many pools outstanding
GUS: 30 odd
DEVI: you’re kiddingme right? if you finish all the pools by next weekend – I’ll skinning dip in every single one of them.

VO: While some pools were completed, it’s not the 30 as promised by Gus .

Hannes, Christelle and Magen’s pool are still not complete.

Rapid Pools agreed to refund Christelle R20000, while the terms have not been finalised - she got a R2500 installment.

D – Hannes Scholtz?
A – we have been behind specifically on him
D – why?
A – becaseu of everything else?
D – what everything else?
A – all the other clients, the rain, the suppliers the everything – we were at him last week

HANNES: I got a different contractor in due to start finishing my pool. // I cannot wait anymore. INT3 M15

VO: Magen paid in full in July this year.

D - what problem since July – no rain in July M34
A – suppliers//
D – for Magen’s pool – why didn’t supply
A – not that they didn’t supply, they have scehduels M34

MAGEN: I'm extremely disappointed. I've put my trust in them and they've let me down.












PROMOS
PROMO 1
VO: With more than 80 unhappy customers, a history of bad workmanship and non-delivery going back at least a year, we expose a Joburg pool contractor who’s left client high and dry.


PROMO 2
VO: The MO is simple: Take a deposit, dig a pit, do some basic work, don’t finish the job! We investigate a pool contractor who appears to over-promise and under deliver.

PROMO 3
VO: Winning new clients with stunning proposals and claims of having finished 300 sparkling pools, we expose a Joburg pool contractor’s broken promises and non-delivery.

I waited and then I waited // VO: It seems at Rapid Pools has some explaining to do – so we booked another quote – this time Gus’ wife and co-director – Amy – showed up . UPSOUND SOME ALLEGATIONS VO: After calling her lawyer, she sat down for an interview. AMY: I don’t know where you getting that we aren’t doing the right thing and that we haven’t completed pools // Would you like to see some photos of pools VO: On their Facebook page there are a number of pools, some even recently completed. Rapid Pools sent us a list of 6 so-called happy clients. Our own research revealed – of the 6 - one was happy, four got pools but say they will never recommend the company, and the last one didn’t even get a pool, he never even got his deposit refunded.. UPSOUND: DONOVAN UPSOUND: HENDRIK VO: We contacted an additional 83 Rapid Pools clients from 2018 & 2019 – 69 of them did not get a completed pool having made phase payments ranging from 10 to 75 000 rand. These are some photos of Rapid Pools’ work. Rapid Pools questioned the figures of clients we contacted versus apparent pools incomplete stating: it “is very wrong... and in our eyes...impossible as we bragged of a 100% completion rate...up until early this year.” We telephonically contacted each of the 83 clients we refer to – they all have similar stories. Our undercover operative was also promised a quick turn around job. PRODUCER: How long does it take to do a pool? GUS: You’ve got your first 10 days, then the concrete must stand for 10 days – then the finishes is 10 days – so you can work on worst case scenario, work on a month. / 0006 M1 JOHN: // when you turn around and you said okay you know what I've been waiting for six months in it will tell you it's not 15 consecutive days // VO: None the 83 people we spoke to got a new pool within a month – there were endless delays in the majority of cases. MAGEN: //Basically anything that affects South Africa affects them. They find some way to type into the construction DEVI: ever built in 20 days AMY – not consecutive DEVI: can’t get done? AMY: – cant get done DEVI: Delays? M15 AMY: because rain – we hit rock, supplier delays – protests – how do you want us to work in conditions like that? DEVI: you are making excuses AMY: you can think whateer you want VO: Some of their clients think they’re scamsters . CHRISTELLE: // they are thieves and they get away with it every day. // taking people's hard earned money // and then have the audacity to threaten all of us with legal action // INT3 M32 VO: Clients are reguluarly referred to the detailed Rapid Pools service level agreement, or SLA, that they were given with the quote. LINK: As a consumer you might think a detailed contract and service level agreement will have you covered – but if the contractor isn’t honourable you could be in deep water. VO: The contract is one sided , more than half of all the people we spoke to said they were threatened with breach of contract. JOHN: If you go to social media, you're in breach of contract you will lose the deposits and you won't finish the job you won't finish a job. But that's what he wants it's a one sided contract is to protect him and then only. AMY – // client agrees to the terms of the contract. DEVI – do you know your contract is actually invalid? AMY – The accepted the contents – my attorneys drafted up this. DEVI – constitution and laws of country AMY – yah – CPA is for clients // REGGIE: No it's definitely for her - that's why the act is there to balance the interests of the supplier and also the consumer. VO: Attorney Reginald Thsabalala assessed the Rapid Pools contract. He found it to be vague, misrepresentative and in contravention of the constitution and the National Credit Act. REGGIE: You can’t choose // whatever pleases you in the contract and see that it's binding in a country such as ours where there are laws and see that you will you will operate in isolation to our laws. VO: But Amy & Gus believe they’re in the right and are quick to take clients on when they start complaining – threatening them with defamation lawsuits . REGGIE: Something which is true that cannot serve as a justifiable reason to cancel a contract but in any event those contracts are unenforceable, they’re invalid VO: Gus is the one who usually responds to clients who dare to complain on social media. We interviewed him at home. DEVI: called people names GUS: I did DEVI: unnecessary – not on GUS: I’ve apologised – not one sided // 16.45 DEVI: you’re not the victim here you know that right VO: Of the 83 people we contacted – 14 got pools – but only 1 was happy with their dealings with Rapid Pools . Besides complaints about delays and threats of legal action – some of these clients felt the workmanship was not up to scratch. The Nastional Spa and Pool Institute is a voluntary self-regulatory body of pool builders. Committee member Julian Burch says Rapid Pools is not a member. JULIAN: They applied for membership. // They were declined on the basis that they they they didn't conform to the NSPI standards. VO: Rapid Pools feel the NSPI is not independent because the inspectors belong to rival companies. GUS: There’s no ways a competitor is going to pat us on the back. LINK: When it comes to buidling a pool taking shortcuts or to skimping on materials is a certain road to disaster – in the end the art of pool making requires serious skills and expertise. VO: We asked the NSPI to inspect the work done at Hannes Scholtz’ property. JULIAN: there's a couple of issues there gunnite work. Yeah it's a hand pack but it's still very soft in places. // the weirs the turns the lights they should have all been bolted in the construction phase. // from what I can see, there's no ring beam on the top of the pool which is important for the overall structure GUS: We wouldn’t be where we are today if our work was that bad VO: With only 2% of the clients we called, happy with completed pools – It seems the company has been overreaching and taking on too much work , yet they are still quoting for new jobs. DEVI: Don’t you think that is quite an arrogant – back on all your pools – the ones you need to get done are not done – yet you pitch up here for quotes AMY: attending to all these clients DEVI: AMY: client say they want to start looking at qutoes for new year VO: That wasn’t the case in our first undercover sting. PRODUCER: It would be nice if you could start in the next two - three weeks GUS: Yah, no we can, yah. JOHN: At this point is just trying to stay afloat. //Based on my investigations the rapid pools doesn't have any funds DEVI: I think cash flow problem GUS: because sites were being stretched out – it was hitting our pockets // a merger s happening therir pools will be finished by next weekendw DEVI: how many pools outstanding GUS: 30 odd DEVI: you’re kiddingme right? if you finish all the pools by next weekend – I’ll skinning dip in every single one of them. VO: While some pools were completed, it’s not the 30 as promised by Gus . Hannes, Christelle and Magen’s pool are still not complete. Rapid Pools agreed to refund Christelle R20000, while the terms have not been finalised - she got a R2500 installment. D – Hannes Scholtz? A – we have been behind specifically on him D – why? A – becaseu of everything else? D – what everything else? A – all the other clients, the rain, the suppliers the everything – we were at him last week HANNES: I got a different contractor in due to start finishing my pool. // I cannot wait anymore. D - what problem since July – no rain in July M34 A – suppliers// D – for Magen’s pool – why didn’t supply A – not that they didn’t supply, they have scehduels M34 MAGEN: I'm extremely disappointed. metadata.Summary: Rapid Pools con new clients with proposals and so-called experience - claiming to have finished 300 sparkling pools. Yet we've only tracked down endless upset clients without sparkling pools. Rapid Pools’ MO is simple: Take a deposit, start some work, don’t finish the job! Leaving clients with a ghastly pit in their gardens when they were dreaming of a sparkling pool. People have been ripped off between R10 000 to R220 000. We go undercover to expose these scamsters - outing them once and for all.
metadata.Further information: Rapid Pools’ MO is simple: Take a deposit, start some work, don’t finish the job! Leaving clients with a ghastly pit in their gardens when they were dreaming of a sparkling pool. People have been ripped off between R10 000 to R220 000. They owe suppliers and employees – they simply leave a trail of unpaid bills, unfinished jobs with endless promises to make good – but these promises very rarely materialise. And when they do the workmanship is questionable. RAPID POOLS Rapid Pools and Construction (2016/131234/07) owned by Guthrie (GUS) Cayle Fisher and Amy Crystal Fisher. Long history of acquiring deposits from respective clients and fail to deliver the service as promised, with an exception of 5% of swimming pools completed with inferior materials. Amy is the one that goes out quotes and deals with clients – we are hoping to catch her! EXCUSES They make promises/commitments prior to customers paying, and thereafter refer to their SLA agreement and ignore all agreements and commitments made prior to paying. They provide various excuses for not attending to the site, such as ‘floods’, ‘material supplier issues’, ‘Gus the owner is sick’, etc. None of these are valid excuses and are also not communicated to their customers. No updates of delays are provided. LIKES TO THREATEN PEOPLE An extensive amount of evidence were found were the owner Guthrie (Gus) Fisher threatened and intimidated any victims that tried to warn others or posted on social media in the public’s interest and his lawyer Chinette de Beer from Hinrichsen Attorneys would harass and intimidate clients to remove any negative reviews posted to warn others. Although the publication states factual events of their customer experience, they would be threatened with a ‘defamation of character’ lawsuit, in order for them to remove their publication. Many started posted anonymously due to threats. CASE STUDIES CASE STUDY 1 - CHRISTELLE VAN HEERDEN Started dealing with Rapid Pools in May 2019 – wanted to renovate existing pool and add a splash pool – Met with Amy initially - paid R10 000 deposit in July – waited 3 weeks – no work done. Staff were dropped three times as the property, for between an hour to three – very little work done. If anything they are now worse off then when they started. They were promised it would be finished in August for her husband’s bday, then for her 10 year old daughter’s bday. She has a great pic of all the children in the hole for her daughter’s party. CASE STUDY 2 - MAGEN REDDY Started dealing with Rapid Pools 9 months ago – Amy came out to quote. Only dealt with Amy. Paid for the pool – R60K + in total. The payments were structured in terms of milestones – final two payments were made because Rapid Pools said nothing can be done if they don’t pay up – it would delay materials needed to finish. Magen paid up, they didn’t finish. Last work was done two / three months ago. At this stage he has a concreted pool – a bit of the coping and installed a pump – but no fibre glassing. Amy came out last week to see them to tell them the investigation on FB is fraudulent – promised to finish the work this week – never come. He has a recording – mentioning she will complete it. Amy claims there’s only one upset client. CASE STUDY 3 – 2016/2017 client Finding this person still – choosing best option – looking for someone who dealt with them way back to show pattern over the years. OPERATING OUTSIDE OF CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT In all instances whereby a client requested a start or end date of their project, Rapid Pools would refer back to their SLA agreement which is against the CPA. The SLA agreement state that there is no timeline available and clients are not allowed to request this. The SLA agreement also state that deposits are ‘non-refundable’. Once the customer start to become impatient with the lack of service, they would get a notification that they ‘breached contract’ and then Rapid Pools seem to feel entitled to keep the deposits without the service rendered EXPERTS The National Spa and Pool Institute of South Africa – we interview them as experts what can people look out for - we get them to look at one of the pool and give their expert opinion on the quality of work. But more sexy is the fact Rapid Pools attempted to register with them in the past but were rejected. Rapid pools used the NSPI logo on their advertisements which is a misrepresentation. They were instructed by NSPI to remove their logo from all their advertisements. NSPI also received multiple complaints from various Rapid Pools clients. Rapid Pools have publicly indicated that the NSPI is one of their competitors and trying to dictate industry standards, is jealous of their success and sees them as a threat to their members SUPPLIERS & STAFF We have a hardware store that is owed money, staff that have not been paid – we can interview them on camera as well. INVESTIGATOR – John Alexander John has been tracking Rapid Pools and has pieced together their dodgy dealing having tracked down upset clients all over Gauteng dating back to 16 – he becomes a nice thread to show the extent of these pool cons. HOW TO DO IT - FOOTAGE – We do two undercover stings at different houses – one for sales pitch and hidden camera footage. The second for the bust. WE HAVE AN ADDRESS FOR THEIR HOME, WE WILL HAVE EYES ON THEM IN THE MORNING OF THE BUST – I AM CONFIDENT WE CAN TRACK THEM DOWN.
